domains.name: Awareness
domains.tagline: Reading the threat landscape as it actually moves — beyond sensational headlines, into the mechanics of phishing, social engineering, malware, and emerging attack vectors.
domains.overview: The human element remains the primary attack surface across modern breaches. The Awareness domain equips members with critical intelligence to deconstruct spear-phishing campaigns, behavioral psychology, ransomware economics, and digital privacy.
focusAreas: Cybersecurity intelligence & active global threat campaigns
Online scams, spear-phishing, business email compromise (BEC)
Social engineering behavioral patterns & cognitive biases
Malware families, ransomware payloads, and extortion schemes
Digital privacy, consumer data rights, and surveillance technologies
Emerging attack vectors (voice clones, deepfakes, QR code phishing)
activities: Weekly News Briefings (Recurring intelligence roundups on zero-days and active campaigns)
Awareness Campaigns (Public-facing university drives and scam prevention workshops)
Discussions & Structured Debates (Member-led arguments on digital rights and policies)
Content Creation & Explainers (Publishing student-friendly infographics and threat memos)

learningPathway.title: Phishing Mechanics & Personal Hygiene
learningPathway.description: Inspect email headers (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), analyze deceptive URLs, and implement password manager & hardware MFA standards.
learningPathway.deliverable: Author an interactive scam-detection checklist for university freshmen.

learningPathway.title: Threat Intelligence Synthesis & Campaign Dissection
learningPathway.description: Track APT groups on MITRE ATT&CK, correlate malware IoCs (Indicators of Compromise), and monitor OSINT feeds.
learningPathway.deliverable: Present a 15-minute weekly intelligence briefing dissecting an ongoing ransomware outbreak.

learningPathway.title: Organizational Human Defense & Policy
learningPathway.description: Design ethical simulated phishing programs, evaluate behavioral nudges, and analyze international cyber warfare doctrines.
learningPathway.deliverable: Design and execute a campus-wide Cyber Hygiene Month campaign with measurable impact metrics.

domains.name: Explore
domains.tagline: A platform where students try different non-technical domains, discover their interests and potential, and choose skills they want to develop further.
domains.overview: Not all cybersecurity excellence is code. The Explore domain is 0XNULL's incubator for discovery, communication, and executive leadership. Students discover where their natural talents lie — bridging technical engineering with human leadership, public speaking, event production, and community partnerships.
focusAreas: Discover personal interests beyond conventional technical tracks
Real-world creative, design, & communication projects
Leadership, teamwork, & large-scale event operations
Public relations, community networking, & industry outreach
Interdisciplinary collaboration between technical and non-technical students

appliedAreas.title: Communication & Storytelling
appliedAreas.description: Translating complex CVEs and binary exploits into clear executive narratives.

appliedAreas.title: Public Speaking & Presentations
appliedAreas.description: Delivering keynote conference talks and technical demonstrations with confidence.

appliedAreas.title: Teamwork & Event Management
appliedAreas.description: Orchestrating hackathons, CTFs, guest seminars, and multi-track workshops.

appliedAreas.title: PR & Industry Outreach
appliedAreas.description: Partnering with security firms, alumni practitioners, and national cybersecurity organizations.

learningPathway.title: Community Contribution & Peer Collaboration
learningPathway.description: Join event coordination teams, co-author meeting minutes, and facilitate breakout rooms during workshops.
learningPathway.deliverable: Organize and host a 0XNULL peer study circle with at least 15 attendees.

learningPathway.title: Public Presentation & Workshop Facilitation
learningPathway.description: Develop technical presentation decks, master stage presence, and coordinate speaker logistics for guest lecturers.
learningPathway.deliverable: Deliver a solo 20-minute lightning talk on a technology topic at a club general meeting.

learningPathway.title: Executive Leadership & Partnership Building
learningPathway.description: Lead club operational domains, manage mentorship programs, spearhead industry sponsorships, and guide junior cohorts.
learningPathway.deliverable: Direct the planning and execution of 0XNULL's flagship annual cybersecurity conference.

domains.name: Red & Blue Team
domains.tagline: Two perspectives, one discipline — attack to understand, defend to protect. Every exercise is conducted in controlled labs with documented ethical boundaries.
domains.overview: The Red & Blue Team domain bridges adversarial attack simulations with institutional defense. Members practice both offensive penetration testing techniques to uncover attack vectors and defensive operational telemetry to isolate intrusions, engineer detection rules, and execute incident response drills.
focusAreas: Ethical hacking basics & scoped rules of engagement
Vulnerability assessment & CVE vulnerability mapping
Web application security (OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities)
Reconnaissance techniques (Passive & Active discovery)
Penetration testing execution frameworks
Controlled attack simulations & privilege escalation
Security monitoring & perimeter telemetry analysis
SIEM configuration & log analysis (Splunk, Elastic)
Threat detection rules (YARA, Sigma)
Incident response triage & forensic stabilization

subTracks.name: Red Team (Offensive Practice)
subTracks.description: Thinking from the attacker position — finding architectural and implementation weaknesses before threat actors exploit them.

subTracks.name: Blue Team (Defensive Operations)
subTracks.description: Watching, detecting, responding — building the organizational muscle that shields mission-critical systems.

learningPathway.title: Foundational Reconnaissance & Lab Setup
learningPathway.description: Establish isolated Kali Linux & target VMs. Master Nmap, port scanning, basic HTTP inspection, and packet flows.
learningPathway.deliverable: Complete basic TryHackMe / HackTheBox pre-security rooms and write a reproducible lab verification memo.

learningPathway.title: Web Application Pentesting & Perimeter Defense
learningPathway.description: Analyze SQL injection, cross-site scripting (XSS), authentication bypasses, and configure Suricata IDS rules.
learningPathway.deliverable: Publish a scoped penetration test report and matching Sigma defensive detection rules for an internal vulnerable service.

learningPathway.title: Full Attack-Defence Simulation & Active Directory
learningPathway.description: Participate in live team vs team scenarios, Kerberoasting, golden ticket attacks, and automated endpoint triage.
learningPathway.deliverable: Lead an internal 0XNULL CTF attack-defence session with automated post-incident debrief.

domains.name: Digital Forensics
domains.tagline: Reconstructing events from artefacts — disk, memory and network traces. The discipline of answering "what happened" with evidence, not assumption.
domains.overview: Digital Forensics provides the rigorous methodology required to examine compromised storage media, memory dumps, and protocol traces. Members learn chain of custody protocols, volatile memory analysis, and filesystem timelines to piece together digital crime scenes.
focusAreas: Digital evidence handling & legal chain of custody
Disk forensics & RAW / E01 filesystem image carving
Network forensics & deep protocol trace inspection
Incident investigation & post-breach reconstruction
File systems analysis (NTFS $MFT, EXT4, APFS)
Memory forensics & volatile payload extraction
Log correlation & timeline triage synthesis

toolsCovered.name: Wireshark
toolsCovered.description: Packet capture and network traffic protocol analysis to trace malicious C2 communications and payload exfiltration.

toolsCovered.name: Autopsy
toolsCovered.description: Disk, raw image, and filesystem investigation platform for automated artefact indexing, deleted file carving, and timeline analysis.

toolsCovered.name: Volatility
toolsCovered.description: Volatile memory artefact extraction and malware analysis framework for analyzing process trees, injected DLLs, and memory pools.

learningPathway.title: Artefact Acquisition & Hex Analysis
learningPathway.description: Learn evidence hashing (SHA-256), write-blockers, disk cloning, and hex examination of common file signatures.
learningPathway.deliverable: Verify and document a cryptographic disk image integrity verification report.

learningPathway.title: Network & Memory Incident Extraction
learningPathway.description: Dissect PCAP files for credentials, DNS tunneling, and inspect memory dumps using Volatility 3 to spot hidden threads.
learningPathway.deliverable: Deliver an incident timeline report detailing a simulated employee data-exfiltration breach.

learningPathway.title: Enterprise Incident Response & Anti-Forensics
learningPathway.description: Counter timestomping, rootkits, memory injection, and reconstruct lateral movement across Windows event logs.
learningPathway.deliverable: Publish a forensic case walkthrough with evidence artefacts presented in court-admissible format.

domains.name: Cryptography
domains.tagline: The mathematics that allows two parties to establish trust across an untrusted wire — turning plaintext into ciphertext impenetrable to adversaries.
domains.overview: Cryptography forms the foundational mathematical backbone of all digital trust. Members explore symmetric and asymmetric encryption primitives, cryptographic hashing, digital signatures, public key infrastructure (PKI), and zero-knowledge proof concepts.
focusAreas: Encryption & decryption mathematics and modular arithmetic
Asymmetric cryptography (RSA, Elliptic Curve Cryptography)
Digital signatures, certificates, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)
Symmetric ciphers (AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305)
Cryptographic hashing (SHA-2, SHA-3, BLAKE3, collision resistance)
Key management, exchange protocols (Diffie-Hellman), and HSM architectures
Cryptanalysis, padding oracle attacks, and side-channel vulnerabilities

appliedAreas.title: HTTPS & Secure Protocols
appliedAreas.description: TLS 1.3 handshake, cipher suites negotiation, certificate validation chains, and forward secrecy guarantees.

appliedAreas.title: Authentication & MFA Systems
appliedAreas.description: FIDO2 / WebAuthn public key authentication, HMAC-based OTP (HOTP), and time-based OTP (TOTP) protocols.

appliedAreas.title: Digital Payment Architectures
appliedAreas.description: EMV tokenization, cryptographic message authentication codes (MAC), and tamper-evident ledger validation.

appliedAreas.title: Data at Rest & Transit Protection
appliedAreas.description: Envelop encryption, hardware-backed KMS vaults, transparent database encryption (TDE), and end-to-end encryption.

learningPathway.title: Classical to Modern Primitives
learningPathway.description: Understand modular arithmetic, XOR encryption, Caesar/Vigenère breaks, and modern AES block cipher modes.
learningPathway.deliverable: Implement a zero-dependency symmetric file encrypter in Python using standard libraries with HMAC verification.

learningPathway.title: Public Key Infrastructure & Secure Handshakes
learningPathway.description: Derive RSA and ECC keys, simulate Diffie-Hellman key exchanges, and inspect X.509 certificate chains.
learningPathway.deliverable: Build a private Certificate Authority (CA) that issues, verifies, and revokes client TLS certificates.

learningPathway.title: Cryptanalysis & Quantum-Resistant Algorithms
learningPathway.description: Break weak PRNGs, execute padding oracle attacks, explore lattice-based post-quantum cryptography (Kyber, Dilithium).
learningPathway.deliverable: Publish a technical writeup solving advanced cryptanalytic CTF challenges.

domains.name: Cloud Security
domains.tagline: Most modern systems live in cloud infrastructure. Members learn the shared responsibility model, identity perimeters, and common misconfigurations.
domains.overview: As computing migrates to AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes clusters, the perimeter has shifted from physical firewalls to identity and software-defined networks. This domain trains students to audit cloud environments, enforce least privilege, and harden microservices.
focusAreas: Cloud fundamentals & service models (IaaS / PaaS / SaaS) shared responsibility
Identity & Access Management (IAM roles, least-privilege, permission boundaries)
Cloud networking (VPCs, private subnets, security groups, ingress filtering)
Data protection (S3 bucket policies, transit encryption, KMS customer keys)
Monitoring & observability (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, audit trails, anomaly detection)
Misconfiguration risks (Root causes of 80%+ cloud breaches and remediations)
Container security (Docker image hardening, runtime isolation, Kubernetes RBAC)
Compliance posture (CIS benchmarks, automated audits, Infrastructure as Code scanning)

appliedAreas.title: Cloud Fundamentals
appliedAreas.description: Service models and boundary enforcement across shared responsibility matrices.

appliedAreas.title: Identity & Access (IAM)
appliedAreas.description: Least-privilege policy engineering, ABAC, RBAC, and credential rotation.

appliedAreas.title: Cloud Networking
appliedAreas.description: Virtual private clouds, peering, NAT gateways, and egress filtering rules.

appliedAreas.title: Data Protection & KMS
appliedAreas.description: Server-side bucket encryption, key management hierarchies, and access logs.

appliedAreas.title: Cloud Telemetry & Audit
appliedAreas.description: CloudTrail log correlation, VPC flow logs, and SIEM streaming ingestion.

appliedAreas.title: Misconfiguration Remediation
appliedAreas.description: Detecting exposed storage buckets, wildcard permissions, and unencrypted volumes.

appliedAreas.title: Container & K8s Hardening
appliedAreas.description: Distroless base images, rootless execution, pod security standards, and network policies.

appliedAreas.title: Compliance & CSPM
appliedAreas.description: Cloud Security Posture Management with automated CIS benchmark policy checks.

learningPathway.title: Cloud Foundations & Identity Governance
learningPathway.description: Explore AWS/GCP architecture, configure multi-factor auth, set up least-privilege IAM users, and launch secure VPCs.
learningPathway.deliverable: Configure an AWS lab environment with zero wildcard (*) permissions verified via IAM Access Analyzer.

learningPathway.title: Infrastructure as Code & Container Hardening
learningPathway.description: Write secure Terraform modules, scan templates with Checkov / tfsec, build minimal Docker images, and configure Kube-bench.
learningPathway.deliverable: Deploy a CI/CD pipeline that blocks insecure cloud resources before deployment.

learningPathway.title: Cloud Attack Simulation & Detection Engineering
learningPathway.description: Simulate SSRF against cloud metadata instances, role chaining, privilege escalation, and write detection rules for GuardDuty alerts.
learningPathway.deliverable: Build a serverless automated incident remediation function that isolates compromised EC2 instances within seconds.

domains.name: Security Architecture
domains.tagline: Designing systems where security is structural, not bolted-on — threat-modelled, layered, and resilient against evolving threats.
domains.overview: Security Architecture approaches defense from the structural blueprint. Rather than relying on point solutions, architects design systems where every component assumes breach, enforces Zero Trust verification, and implements multi-layer defense in depth.
focusAreas: Secure system design principles & trust boundary mapping
Zero Trust architecture (Never Trust, Always Verify)
Threat modelling frameworks (STRIDE, PASTA, LINDDUN)
Defence in depth across Perimeter, Network, Host, and Core Data rings
Network zoning, micro-segmentation, and DMZ enclaves
Identity & access governance frameworks
Risk management methodologies & technical trade-offs
Resilient recovery patterns, disaster recovery, and operational fault tolerance

appliedAreas.title: Perimeter Defense
appliedAreas.description: DDoS mitigation, WAF ingress, edge TLS termination, and rate-limiting gateways.

appliedAreas.title: Network Segmentation
appliedAreas.description: Micro-segmented VLANs, zero-trust overlay networks, and internal mutual TLS.

appliedAreas.title: Host & Workload Hardening
appliedAreas.description: OS baseline hardening (CIS), SELinux/AppArmor profiles, and endpoint detection.

appliedAreas.title: Core Data Vaulting
appliedAreas.description: Hardware security modules, envelope encryption, and strict data loss prevention.

learningPathway.title: Threat Modelling Fundamentals
learningPathway.description: Understand the CIA triad, STRIDE threat identification, and data flow diagrams (DFDs).
learningPathway.deliverable: Deliver a STRIDE threat model diagram for a university student registration portal.

learningPathway.title: Zero Trust Network & Micro-segmentation
learningPathway.description: Design software-defined perimeters, mutual TLS authentication between microservices, and identity-aware proxies.
learningPathway.deliverable: Produce an end-to-end architecture diagram showing layered defense for an e-commerce platform.

learningPathway.title: Enterprise Resilience & Disaster Blueprinting
learningPathway.description: Design air-gapped backup topologies, disaster recovery orchestration, and regulatory compliance alignment (NIST CSF, ISO 27001).
learningPathway.deliverable: Defend a complete architectural blueprint in a mock executive board review.

resources.title: Linux Journey: Practical Command Line & Shell Fundamentals
resources.description: Comprehensive, structured walkthroughs on BASH command line navigation, pipes, permissions, and process inspection.

resources.title: Wireshark Packet Analysis & Protocol Dissection
resources.description: Step-by-step guides on packet capture, protocol header analysis, TCP three-way handshake inspection, and DNS resolution tracing.

resources.title: Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces (OSTEP)
resources.description: The premier textbook on virtualization, concurrency, and persistence. Explains kernel vs user space, virtual memory page tables, and file systems.

resources.title: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 Official Reference
resources.description: Authoritative guidance on cybersecurity governance, risk management, threat identification, and the CIA triad defense posture.

resources.title: MITRE ATT&CK: Enterprise Phishing Mechanics (T1566)
resources.description: Dissection of spear-phishing attack attachments, deceptive links, and social engineering campaign execution tactics.

resources.title: Executive Threat Briefing & Security Storytelling
resources.description: Frameworks for translating technical binary CVEs into concise executive summaries, risk reports, and student workshop presentations.

certifications.name: CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701)
certifications.description: Globally recognized baseline credential covering threat analysis, identity access management, risk mitigation, and security architecture principles.

certifications.name: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA 200-301)
certifications.description: Validates technical fluency in network access, IP connectivity, IP services, and security fundamentals across enterprise networks.

certifications.name: Linux Foundation Certified System Administrator (LFCS)
certifications.description: Hands-on, performance-based examination testing command line competency, system automation, and secure Linux service configuration.

projects.title: 0X-PacketTracer
projects.description: A Python-based lightweight network packet inspection and TCP handshake analyzer built for learning packet flows.

projects.title: 0X-LinuxHardener
projects.description: Automated bash script for Ubuntu server CIS benchmark compliance auditing and firewall hardening.
